entries.source: The Meta module contains foundational artifacts used by all other MII implementation guides.
Migration-generated proposal describing the resource types and search parameters published by the Meta module. Review before use as a normative capability statement.

This extension may be used to provide machine-processable license information about the set of data described by this resource.
The extension is a R4-compatible version of the FHIR for FAIR R4B IG Licence Terms as CodeableConcept extension.
